title: Belize Travel Guide: What to Do, See & Eat | EF Go Ahead Tours

facts.fact: The page states that 99.9% of places in Belize accept USD, according to Tour Director Efrain.
facts.quote: “99.9% of places accept USD,” said Tour Director Efrain.

facts.fact: The page states that two Belize dollars (BZD) equal one US dollar (USD).
facts.quote: Remember: Two BZD equals one USD.

facts.fact: The page states that Belize's dry season runs from November through April.
facts.quote: Dry season in Belize runs from November through April.

facts.fact: The page states that Belize's rainy season, also called the offseason, runs from May through October.
facts.quote: Rainy season, or offseason, in Belize lasts from May through October.

facts.fact: The page states that temperatures in Belize's rainy season range from 85 to 90 degrees Fahrenheit.
The page states that temperatures in Belize's dry season are typically in the 80s (Fahrenheit).
facts.quote: Temperatures are typically in the 80s, making the weather ideal for going to the beach

facts.fact: The page states that Efrain, a Belize-native tour director, has been leading EF tours for about eight years.
facts.quote: “I’ve been leading EF tours for about eight years now

facts.fact: The page states that Belize is bordered to the north by Mexico and to the west and south by Guatemala, with the Caribbean Sea to the east.
facts.quote: This tropical wonderland is bordered to the north by Mexico, to the west and south by Guatemala, and to the east is the beautiful Caribbean Sea,

facts.fact: The page states that English is Belize's official language, with Spanish, Belizean Creole, and Mayan languages such as K'iche' and Yucatec Maya also heard.
facts.quote: English is the official language, but you’ll also hear Spanish, Belizean Creole, and Mayan languages

facts.fact: The page was published by the Go Ahead Tours team on April 24, 2025.
